title: Riverside, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Riverside, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Riverside is a city in CA with a population of 314,998. Inland Empire city with citrus heritage, cheaper than coastal CA, but still pricey. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9b growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 277 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.1.
